description: This file provides functions for converting JSON data to and from MessagePack format, including JSON string parsing, cJSON object packing, and MessagePack object printing as JSON.

methods.name: format_string
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a JSON string.

methods.name: msgpack_pack_str_with_body
methods.description: Helper to pack a string with its length into MessagePack format.

methods.name: parse_cjson_object
methods.description: Recursively packs a cJSON object into MessagePack format.

methods.name: msgpack_pack_jsonstr
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into cJSON and packs it into MessagePack format.

methods.name: bytes_contain_zero
methods.description: Checks if a MessagePack binary object contains zero byte.

methods.name: msgpack_object_print_jsonstr
methods.description: Converts a MessagePack object to a JSON string.

methods.name: json_to_blob
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to MessagePack binary buffer.

methods.name: blob_to_json
methods.description: Converts MessagePack binary buffer to a JSON string.
